what is a Roth IRA?

A Roth IRA is a retirement account where you contribute after-tax dollars and qualified withdrawals in retirement are tax-free, including earnings. Contribution limits are $7,500 for 2026 (plus $1,100 catch‑up if 50+). You can withdraw your original contributions anytime penalty- and tax-free; earnings withdrawn before age 59½ or before the account is 5 years old may face taxes and penalties.
